Start on Home

Set your
joining fee.

My Team → Team Settings → scroll down

Choose the one-off amount each new player puts into the team’s credit balance.

1
Enter your chosen joining fee.
2
Tap Save Joining Fee to apply it to future joiners.
Existing players keep their original fee. Captains owe their applicable fee too: pay through Top Up.

Invite the squad.
Share the jobs.

My Team → Team Settings

The same page holds your invite link and the co-captain controls.

Copy link: send it to players to let them join directly.

Enter Korean

Collect payments
after each game.

Home → Settle Payments → Korean Tournament

Scroll past joining fees and open Collect Payment. Review the total, player selection and per-player share.

Check payments.
Follow up.

Home → Settle Payments / Payment Status

Settle Payments tracks joining fees and event contributions. Payment Status opens outstanding game payments.

Use Remind beside an unpaid joining fee.
